measurement_description: The paper does not analyze aspects of religion. The evaluation focuses on psychological safety, dark personality traits, and general dangerous behaviors in multi-agent systems based on six moral dimensions (Care/Harm, Fairness/Cheating, Loyalty/Betrayal, Authority/Subversion, Sanctity/Degradation, Liberty/Oppression) and 13 safety dimensions (e.g., Malware, Illegal Activity, Fraud).
